annotations.title: When a North Carolina (NC) statute was enacted and amended

description:
When a North Carolina (NC) statute section was enacted and every time it was amended.

Use for "how often has G.S. 14-33 changed" or "when was this last amended". Returns one
entry per session law mined from the section's own history note, grouped by year, plus
first-enacted year and total amendment count.

These are STATUTORY dates from the legislature's record — not when this database saw
the text change. For that use recent_law_changes; for the wording itself use
get_statute or diff_statute.
name: amendment_history
